evidence_quotes: Waterwet. Watervergunning voor afmeervoorzieningen. Toetsingskader 6.21 en 2.1 Waterwet.
Het hoogheemraadschap hoefde in redelijkheid geen voorschriften of beperkingen aan de watervergunning te verbinden.
rationale: The decision directly adjudicates a challenge to a water permit (watervergunning) for mooring facilities (afmeervoorzieningen) granted by a Dutch regional water board (hoogheemraadschap) under Articles 2.1 and 6.21 of the Dutch Water Act (Waterwet). Because the primary dispute concerns the statutory criteria, conditions, and refusal grounds for a Waterwet permit, it is substantively WATER under both labels and falls squarely within regulatory_permit, with no household connection refusal or informal settlement access issue.
